name: bigintersmind
description: Claude Code workflow skills: spec-to-ship shapes work before it hits an editor (spec → prd → issues → triage, with diagnose and tdd companions); pr-merge takes a finished pull request through review to merge.

plugins.name: spec-to-ship
plugins.description: Pre-code workflow that walks a fuzzy idea through alignment (spec), PRD, and tracer-bullet issues (issues, triage) — landing tickets in a state where an AFK loop can pick them up. Includes diagnose and tdd companion skills.

plugins.name: pr-merge
plugins.description: Review-to-merge workflow for GitHub pull requests: multi-agent review, verified and triaged findings, worker-implemented fixes, local checks, CI to green, and a squash-merge that waits for an explicit human OK. Lives in its own repo.
